Variants.Content: Celtigar Castle is a coastal stronghold along the Crab Claw Peninsula and is connected to the ancient Valyrian bloodline legend of the Celtigar family. This type of peninsula castle is not based on its broad hinterland, but on its bays, fishing grounds, shallow water routes and observation of ships coming along the coast. The Crab Claw Peninsula juts out into the Narrow Sea, and land routes are not as smooth as rivers and roads, so sea routes are more important; locals not only interact with the King's Landing market, but also have to adapt to the risks of storms, smuggling, and piracy. Cetiga Fort reminds another side of the royal aristocracy: they are not all courtiers in the Red Castle, but also people who rely on salt, fish, boats and sea fog to maintain their territory.

Entry Claw Isle They care about fishing, salt industry, wharves, volcanic rock fields and narrow sea shipping. They also care about whether seeds are left after harvesting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
